author: National Geographic
description:
What secrets lie buried beyond the walls of ancient Rome?  In this Lost Treasures of Rome Season 2 MEGA Episode from National Geographic, expert archaeologists excavate buried desert cities in Jordan, unearth the dark side of Pompeii, and analyze the front line of the ancient empire. With each new discovery, they shed new light on one of the most impactful ancient civilizations in the history of humanity. 

Featuring three full episodes: 

Rome's Desert Cities - 00:00 
Archaeologists excavate a buried city in Jordan, dive a sunken temple in Italy, and explore Petra to shed new light on how Rome conquered the east.

Pompeii's Forgotten Victims - 44:03 
In 79AD Pompeii was destroyed by nearby volcano, Mount Vesuvius. Now archaeologists are digging to uncover the dark side of the town.

Battle on Rome's Frontier - 1:28:06
Archaeologists are excavating the vast frontier of the Roman Empire, investigating the battle to keep it safe.
